terrace_wall_upkeep.name: Terrace Wall Upkeep
terrace_wall_upkeep.observation: After every heavy rain the terrace walls are walked and rebuilt, before one fallen stretch brings down the slope below.

foreign_plant_gardens.name: Foreign Plant Gardens
foreign_plant_gardens.observation: Trees and herbs brought home by envoys and armies are planted in the royal gardens to see what will grow.

thin_soil_grassland.name: Thin Soils Left in Grass
thin_soil_grassland.observation: Uplands where the soil is a hand deep are left in grass, because the plough strips them to rock in a few years.

locust_egg_digging.name: Locust Egg Digging
locust_egg_digging.observation: In spring whole villages dig out the locust egg pods before they hatch.

downstream_herd_watering.name: Herds Watered Downstream
downstream_herd_watering.observation: Herds drink below the place where people draw water, so the drinking pools stay clean.

smelter_fuel_depletion_watch.name: Smelter Woodland Watch
smelter_fuel_depletion_watch.observation: The woods around the iron hearths are watched, and when the cutting reaches the far hills a sector is rested.
smelter_fuel_depletion_watch.ability_reason: Iron eats whole hillsides of charcoal; unless the woods are rested, the smelters strip the country bare.

nesting_season_netting_ban.name: Nesting-season Netting Ban
nesting_season_netting_ban.observation: No one nets birds while they sit on their eggs, and the flocks come back each autumn as thick as before.

goat_hillside_exclusion.name: Goats Kept Off Regrowth
goat_hillside_exclusion.observation: Goats are herded away from hillsides where young trees are coming back, for one goat undoes a year of growth.
goat_hillside_exclusion.social_consequence: Goatherds lose their best browse and quarrel with the wood-wardens.

lined_tanning_pits.name: Clay-lined Tanning Pits
lined_tanning_pits.observation: Tanning and retting pits are lined with packed clay, so their foul water no longer seeps into the wells.

well_drawdown_watch.name: Well Drawdown Watch
well_drawdown_watch.observation: Well-keepers mark the water line each season and see it sinking where too many wells are drawn too hard.

oasis_water_shares.name: Oasis Water Shares
oasis_water_shares.observation: Each family draws the tunnel water for its fixed hours, and no one may dig a new cut that robs the source.
oasis_water_shares.social_consequence: Water turns are law; a family's hours pass to its heirs, and quarrels go before judges.

night_folding_on_fallow.name: Night Folding on Fallow
night_folding_on_fallow.observation: Flocks are penned on the fallow at night, and by spring the field is dunged for the next crop.

charcoal_licensing.name: Charcoal Licensing
charcoal_licensing.observation: A charcoal burner may cut only the wood named in his licence, and pays for what he takes.

flood_height_gauges.name: Flood Gauges
flood_height_gauges.observation: Stepped gauges on the riverbank show how high the flood rose, and from it the priests foretell the harvest and the tax.

crop_raider_culls.name: Crop Raider Culls
crop_raider_culls.observation: Deer and boar that raid the fields are driven and killed each autumn.

game_wardens.name: Game Wardens
game_wardens.observation: Wardens guard the hunting reserves, and a poacher caught there loses his catch and pays a fine.
game_wardens.social_consequence: The best game is kept for the great; villagers who hunt as their fathers did are now poachers.

slag_heap_capping.name: Slag Heap Capping
slag_heap_capping.observation: Old slag heaps are covered with earth and planted, so the rain no longer washes poison into the streams.

fruit_tree_sparing_custom.name: Orchards Spared in War
fruit_tree_sparing_custom.observation: Even raiders leave the olive and fig trees standing, for a cut orchard takes a lifetime to regrow.

dry_season_fire_bans.name: Dry-season Fire Bans
dry_season_fire_bans.observation: In the dry months no one may burn stubble or clear land with fire, and a careless burner pays for the damage.

fodder_legume_fields.name: Fodder Legume Fields
fodder_legume_fields.observation: Vetch and clover sown as fodder feed the herds and leave the field richer for the grain that follows.

hay_meadow_management.name: Hay Meadow Rotation
hay_meadow_management.observation: Meadows are mown in turn and some left uncut each year, so the grass seeds and the meadow thickens.

town_dung_collectors.name: Town Dung Collectors
town_dung_collectors.observation: Hired collectors carry the town's dung and refuse out through the gates and sell it to farmers.

naval_timber_reserves.name: Ship-timber Crown Forests
naval_timber_reserves.observation: The tallest forests are marked for the ruler's ships, and no one else may cut a mast or a keel there.
naval_timber_reserves.ability_reason: The fleets need forests no villager may touch; timber has become a matter of state.
naval_timber_reserves.social_consequence: Villagers who cut there for generations are now thieves in the ruler's wood.

dune_fixing_plantings.name: Dune Fixing
dune_fixing_plantings.observation: Brush fences and planted grasses hold the moving sand before it buries the fields.

saline_drain_channels.name: Saline Drains
saline_drain_channels.observation: Deep drains carry the salty water off the irrigated fields and down into the marshes.
saline_drain_channels.social_consequence: The salt leaves our fields and ruins the marsh villages downstream.

sewage_field_irrigation.name: Sewage Field Irrigation
sewage_field_irrigation.observation: Town sewage is led out along channels onto the outlying fields, which grow heavy crops.

orchard_pest_smokes.name: Orchard Pest Smokes
orchard_pest_smokes.observation: Smoky fires of sulfur and bitter herbs drive off the pests, and plant juices are sprinkled on the leaves.

steep_slope_forest_retention.name: Steep Forests Kept Standing
steep_slope_forest_retention.observation: Forests on the steep slopes are left uncut, because the cleared hills have washed their soil into the valleys and the harbors.
steep_slope_forest_retention.ability_reason: The bare hills upriver taught the lesson: soil lost from a cleared slope does not come back.

tree_nurseries.name: Tree Nurseries
tree_nurseries.observation: Seedlings raised in nursery beds are planted out on cleared ground and fenced until they stand.

plant_habitat_treatise.name: Treatise on Plants and Places
plant_habitat_treatise.observation: A scholar sets down which plants grow on which soil, slope and water, and how each fares when moved.
plant_habitat_treatise.ability_reason: Knowledge of where things grow no longer dies with each gardener.

harbor_silting_link.name: Harbor Silting Traced
harbor_silting_link.observation: The harbor mouth that once took deep ships is now a marsh, and the silt is traced to the hills cleared upriver.
harbor_silting_link.social_consequence: Dredging crews fight the river mouth every year, and old harbor towns are left stranded inland.

timber_export_limits.name: Timber Export Limits
timber_export_limits.observation: Building timber may no longer be sold abroad; the forest's beams are kept for the realm's own halls and ships.

migratory_beehives.name: Migratory Beehives
migratory_beehives.observation: Hives ride on barges and carts from one blooming valley to the next, and the bees work all season.

smoky_trades_zoning.name: Smoky Trades Zoned Out
smoky_trades_zoning.observation: Potters, smiths, tanners and lime burners must work outside the walls, where their smoke and stench trouble no one.

common_pasture_fees.name: Common Pasture Fees
common_pasture_fees.observation: Each head grazed on the common pays a fee, and the rich man's herds no longer eat out the poor man's share.
common_pasture_fees.social_consequence: The poor pay for grass their grandfathers took freely, and the rich pay and graze on.

field_vole_control.name: Field Vole Control
field_vole_control.observation: When the voles swarm, the fields are flooded and trapped until the burrows are empty.

benched_quarry_faces.name: Benched Quarry Faces
benched_quarry_faces.observation: Quarrymen work the face in steps, so the spoil stays on the benches instead of burying the valley below.

protected_drove_roads.name: Protected Drove Roads
protected_drove_roads.observation: Broad drove roads between summer and winter pastures are kept open, and farmers may not plough across them.

seaweed_harvest_rotation.name: Seaweed Manure Seasons
seaweed_harvest_rotation.observation: Seaweed is cut for manure only in set seasons, so the beds regrow and the fish still shelter in them.

pasture_matched_breeds.name: Breeds Matched to Pasture
pasture_matched_breeds.observation: Hardy small sheep go to the hills and heavy cattle to the lowland meadows, each thriving where the other would starve.

local_extirpation_watch.name: Vanished Beasts Noticed
local_extirpation_watch.observation: Old hunters note that the bear, the wild ox and the lion are gone from the settled districts and will not return.
local_extirpation_watch.social_consequence: The great beasts live on only in songs and on the painted walls of the halls.

river_fish_restocking.name: River Restocking
river_fish_restocking.observation: Fry raised in ponds are carried in jars and released into fished-out rivers and lakes.

press_cake_fuel.name: Press-cake Fuel
press_cake_fuel.observation: Where no trees stand, pressed olive pulp is dried into cakes and burned in bath furnaces and ovens.

staged_acclimatization.name: Staged Acclimatization
staged_acclimatization.observation: Foreign fruit trees are moved in stages through warmer, then cooler gardens until they bear in our own valleys.

volcanic_soil_choice.name: Volcanic Soils for Vines
volcanic_soil_choice.observation: Growers seek the dark ash soils on the mountain's flanks, where the vines give the richest wine.

brush_check_dams.name: Brush Check Dams
brush_check_dams.observation: Low dams of brush and stone across the gullies slow the runoff and catch the soil it carries.

tall_smelter_flues.name: Tall Smelter Flues
tall_smelter_flues.observation: Tall flues carry the smelting fumes high above the works; the fields beside them recover, though a haze now drifts over farther valleys.
tall_smelter_flues.ability_reason: The fumes that poisoned the smelter crews and the nearby crops now rise and scatter, spread thin over a wider country.

water_source_trials.name: Water Sources Judged by Health
water_source_trials.observation: Before a town draws on a new spring, physicians look at the health, teeth and color of those who already drink it.

public_shade_groves.name: Public Shade Groves
public_shade_groves.observation: Plane trees planted along the streets and in public groves shade the city in summer.

wetland_plot_leases.name: Wetland Plot Leases
wetland_plot_leases.observation: Reed beds and sedge meadows are leased by plot and season, and each tenant must leave his plot to regrow.

vine_stake_coppice.name: Vine-stake Coppice
vine_stake_coppice.observation: Chestnut and willow are coppiced for vine stakes, so the vineyards stop stripping the woods for poles.

liming_sour_soils.name: Liming Sour Soils
liming_sour_soils.observation: Burned lime and dug marl spread on sour fields make them bear wheat where only rye and bracken grew.

net_mesh_limits.name: Net Mesh Limits
net_mesh_limits.observation: Nets must have a mesh wide enough to let the young fish through, and inspectors cut up the fine ones.

planned_wetland_drainage.name: Planned Wetland Drainage
planned_wetland_drainage.observation: Engineers drain whole lakes and marshes under a state plan, and the old lakebeds become wheat fields.
planned_wetland_drainage.social_consequence: The marsh folk who lived by fowl, fish and reed lose their living to the new fields.

spring_yield_gauging.name: Spring Yield Gauging
spring_yield_gauging.observation: A spring's flow is gauged through the dry season before an aqueduct is built to it, so the city does not tap a failing source.

mine_tailing_ponds.name: Tailing Ponds
mine_tailing_ponds.observation: The muddy water from the washed-out hillside mines is held in ponds until the silt settles, before it reaches the river.

long_haul_timber_imports.name: Imported Building Timber
long_haul_timber_imports.observation: With the home forests cut out, the long beams for roofs and ships now come by sea from far forests.
long_haul_timber_imports.social_consequence: The realm's halls and fleets now hang on forests it does not own.

city_firewood_supply.name: Managed City Firewood Rings
city_firewood_supply.observation: Rings of coppice and woodland around the city are cut in turn, and the fuel carts never go farther than a day's haul.
city_firewood_supply.ability_reason: A great city burns a forest a year; managed rings keep its fires lit without leaving the hills bare.

pasture_reseeding.name: Pasture Reseeding
pasture_reseeding.observation: Overgrazed grassland is broken, sown with good grass seed and closed to the herds until the turf binds again.

embanked_salt_meadows.name: Embanked Salt Meadows
embanked_salt_meadows.observation: Behind new sea dikes the salt marsh becomes grazing for sheep and cattle.

worn_field_retirement.name: Worn Fields Retired
worn_field_retirement.observation: Fields that no longer repay the seed are left to grass and scrub, to rest for a generation.

forest_supervisors.name: Forest Supervisors
forest_supervisors.observation: Appointed supervisors mark the timber that may be felled in the state woods, and answer for any that is stolen.
forest_supervisors.ability_reason: The realm's woods have officers of their own, and every felled tree must answer to a register.

raptor_nesting_encouragement.name: Owls and Hawks at Granaries
raptor_nesting_encouragement.observation: Nest boxes and perches bring owls and hawks to the granaries, and they take the mice the cats miss.

flood_overflow_reserves.name: Flood Overflow Grounds
flood_overflow_reserves.observation: Low wild ground along the river is kept unbuilt, so the flood spreads there instead of into the town.

forest_inventory_counts.name: Forest Tallies
forest_inventory_counts.observation: Clerks count the standing timber in each state forest and record what may be cut in the coming years.

snowpack_flow_forecast.name: Snowpack Flow Forecasts
snowpack_flow_forecast.observation: Watchers read the snow on the mountains in late winter and foretell whether the summer river will run high or low.

cross_slope_ploughing.name: Cross-slope Ploughing
cross_slope_ploughing.observation: Ploughmen turn their furrows across the slope, not down it, so the rain no longer carries the soil away.
